page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.ebmc6.26xlarge is an x86_64 architecture bare-metal instance featuring 104 dedicated vCPUs and 192.0 GB of system memory. Operating on a KVM hypervisor, this server type provides a compute-heavy resource profile with approximately 1.85 GB of RAM per core. It does not include local storage or integrated GPU hardware, relying instead on network-attached storage options.

The instance is equipped with a baseline network bandwidth of 32 Gbps, supporting high-throughput data transfers. From a cost-efficiency perspective, the dedicated CPU allocation and high core density make it suitable for workloads requiring sustained, predictable compute resources without the overhead of virtualization layers. The lack of bundled local storage and GPUs allows resource allocation to focus entirely on raw CPU processing power and network performance.

Given its high core count and compute-to-memory ratio, the ecs.ebmc6.26xlarge is designed for compute-intensive workloads. Appropriate use cases include high-performance computing (HPC), large-scale batch processing, web serving at scale, and CPU-bound simulation tasks.
